timing: After inspecting raw initial proposals and before any actor-scored trajectory or source label.
reason: Base Qwen sometimes emits a Bash-comment spelling of both action delimiters around an otherwise unambiguous command batch.
rule: Accept a complete line-delimited # action ... # /action pair as an alias for <action> ... </action>. Never infer a missing close delimiter. Apply the same parse() function to cached initial completions, all new actor drafts and all revisions. Sampling, token budget, task allocation and scoring remain as registered.
